experiment: C1 confirmatory synthetic concept cohort v2
purpose: Semantic and style audit after mechanical corpus generation and before any activation extraction.

permitted: frozen reciprocal hard-negative title and summary
the six generated requests for that concept

document_checks.pass_rule: A competent answer must centrally use the assigned concept rather than merely mentioning adjacent vocabulary.
The request must not centrally require the reciprocal hard-negative concept or combine both sides as co-equal targets.
No named person, organization, branded product, specific place, URL, or four-digit year. Generic institutions and technical terms are allowed.
The text is a user request for an explanation or analysis, not a supplied answer.
The request is prose, without code, tables, formula blocks, or list-form content.

concept_batch_checks.pass_rule: All six requests use substantively distinct applications or scenarios, not surface paraphrases of one setup.
Neither held-out scenario duplicates or directly continues a discovery scenario.
No concept uniquely relies on code, equations, named entities, or a distinctive list/template style that can serve as a label shortcut.

decision_rule: Every document and concept-batch check must pass. Any failure stops v2; no text is edited and no document or concept is selectively regenerated.

required_output.reviewer_rule: Two independent reviews are recorded; any disagreement or failure is resolved conservatively as FAIL before activation extraction.
